name: Brightside Info
description: Reports Brightside desktop app and venue information: app name and version, the venue name and DID, the store and process this instance holds, and the default skills Brightside ships. Useful for diagnostics and to confirm the app is running against this venue.

version.description: Application version, or 'dev' when run from a build

skills.description: Brightside's default skills, seeded under v/skills/brightside

store.description: The venue store this instance holds: a file path, or 'temp'

pid.description: The operating-system process id of this instance
